column1: # The mutation sets: each a package and the files of it whose mutants are
# graded, with its exact manifest at tools/mutants/manifests/<set>.txt.
#   set   <name>  <package>  <file globs, space-separated, relative to the repo root>
#   skip  <name>  <test name filter>  <why the set's mutants never face it>
# A `skip` passes `--skip <filter>` to the test binaries (a substring match), so
# every test whose name contains it is left out of the baseline and of every
# mutant's run. A mutant only a skipped test could kill comes out `missed`. Each
# set's manifest header lists its skips.
